enrichment.summary: Enforces multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all users on any platform when medium or high sign-in risk is detected, ensuring secure access to all applications.
enrichment.rationale: This policy helps organisations minimise the risk of unauthorised access by requiring additional authentication steps when suspicious or risky sign-in behaviour is identified.
enrichment.userImpact: Users may be prompted to complete MFA if their sign-in is flagged as medium or high risk.
